item.title: Netanyahu says Israel expects war with Iran to last weeks, not days
item.description: In closed-door remarks to local leaders, PM says aiming to end war’s most intensive phase before Passover or reduce Iran’s launch capabilities enough to shift to emergency routine, warns regime change in Tehran cannot be imposed 'at the push of a button'

item.title: Nonstop sirens in north as Hezbollah fires at Haifa
item.description: About 10 rockets and drones set off fresh alerts across the Galilee after a heavier barrage earlier in the night, while Israeli strikes send smoke billowing over Beirut’s Dahieh; officials warn against another Majdal Shams-type disaster

item.title: 'Be safe, strike hard': cockpit audio offers glimpse of US-Israeli mission over Iran
item.description: 'It is a great honor for us to fight with you': IDF releases radio traffic showing Israeli, US pilots exchanging praise, as both countries say their air forces operate in full coordination over Iran

item.title: Heavy fire from Lebanon, Iran raises stakes for Israel as war set to expand
item.description: Waves of fire from Lebanon and Iran send Israelis to shelters across the country; senior official says broad campaign in Lebanon near and reservists would be mobilized

item.title: Iran downs Israeli drones as fighter jets maneuver to evade air defenses near missile launch sites
item.description: Iran has shot down several Israeli drones during the war while surface-to-air missiles have also threatened fighter jets, forcing pilots to maneuver midair to avoid hits as the Israeli Air Force hunts missile launchers and works to curb Tehran’s attacks

item.title: The Christian village caught between Israel and Hezbollah — spared by the IDF
item.description: Residents of Rmeish near Israel’s border remain in their homes despite fighting, but Israeli military warns it will strike if Hezbollah operatives hide among displaced civilians seeking refuge there

item.title: Trump says 'practically nothing left' to strike in Iran, but officials brace for more fighting
item.description: US president says war will end whenever he decides, even as US and Israeli officials privately prepare for at least two more weeks of fighting and Netanyahu says conflict could last several more weeks

item.title: Israel says war with Iran and Hezbollah will last 'only a few weeks'
item.description: Finance Ministry lowered its economic growth forecast for 2026, with the economy now projected to grow 4.7% in 2026, down from a previous forecast of 5.2%

item.title: דובר צה"ל: "כל יום במלחמה מרחיק את הסבב הבא"
item.description: תת-אלוף אפי דפרין הסביר כי השיגורים האחרונים לישראל הם "תגובה ללחץ הגובר שאנחנו מפעילים על איראן", והוסיף במענה לשאלת ynet: "יצאנו למערכה הזאת כדי למנוע מציאות של חזרה לסבבים באופן תכוף פעם אחר פעם". על המשך המערכה אמר: "הסרה של איום עשויה להימשך לאורך זמן"

item.title: "ירי נרחב": המסר של צה"ל לראשי הרשויות - ושינוי ההנחיות
item.description: תדרוך של צה"ל לראשי רשויות, והודעות שפרסמו בעקבותיו, הובילו מיליוני תושבים להיערך לירי בהיקף חריג. גורמים ישראלים אמרו ל-CNN כי יש היערכות לכך, ודובר צה"ל לא שלל זאת בהבהרה שפרסם. זמן קצר לאחר מכן מטחים שוגרו מלבנון ואיראן, ופיקוד העורף הנחה את כל תושבי הצפון לשהות סמוך למרחב ...
